summary: The filing is a Form 8-K reporting routine items from ONE Group Hospitality's 2026 annual meeting: election of three Class I directors, ratification of Deloitte as auditor, advisory vote on executive compensation, and approval of an amendment to the 2019 Equity Incentive Plan. The registrant is the issuer filing standard governance results. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is mentioned. Item 8.01 merely notes an updated investor presentation on the company's website, which is not a substantive extraordinary corporate event.
